subject: english
question: **What do you understand by 'mindfulness'?**

options.text: Consciousness of one's fears and doubts

solution:
The correct answer is "**Awareness of experience without judgment**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the last part of the passage, it is mentioned that **mindfulness **is a practice that helps the individual stay in a moment by bringing **awareness of his or her experience without judgment.**
 
• It is also mentioned that this practice has been used to quiet the **noise of their fears and doubts**.
 
• The author believes that by practicing mindfulness, individuals have the ability to stop the self-sabotaging downward spiral of hopelessness, despair, and frustration.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**
